note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list exactly as reported (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Every guide below is written by us, in our own words, from the official description — nothing here was copied from another guide, and no location is given that we have not verified. Where a place is not pinned down, the guide says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the reward for the other 54 trophies, so there is no separate task. Work through the roadmap in this guide: story first, then the stranger strands and character finales, then activities and challenges, then collectibles and exploration, then the combat and robbery trophies, with 100% completion as the last big gate. A Long Road (100% completion) is the final hurdle for most hunters.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this unlocks as you start the story. Just play the introduction and follow the on-screen objectives; nothing here can be missed. It is the first trophy most players will earn.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing through its missions in order. Story trophies unlock as the chapters end, so there is no extra task beyond the story itself. If you are tracking progress, this is the first chapter checkpoint.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. By this point both protagonists are in play and several side activities open up — but the trophy itself only needs the chapter finished. Keep playing the story missions and it will pop at the chapter's end.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Same as the other chapter trophies: finish the chapter's missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the end. The chapter trophies are unmissable as long as you keep playing the story.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Finish its missions and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. After this, only the final mission stands between you and the story's gold trophy.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the story's last mission and the second gold trophy in the list. There is no confirmed mission replay, so keep a manual save from before the finale in case you want to revisit the ending — the trophy itself only needs the mission finished once.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock in order as you play, so just keep following the story. The name and description are all the official list gives us; the mission's exact place in the story is not pinned down here.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission — play through the story and it comes in order. Expect a big set-piece heist, but the official list does not say where or when it falls, so we will not guess.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story mission; it unlocks in sequence. No extra requirement beyond finishing the mission — just follow the story markers when it appears.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story mission; finish it as part of the story. The description gives no location or setup, so follow the in-game mission markers when it unlocks.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. VCIA is Vice City International Airport, named in the trophy itself, so this one takes place at the airport. Finish the mission as it comes up in the story.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission; finish it in sequence. The name suggests a large operation, but the official list gives no details, so we do not invent a walkthrough here.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the hardest trophy and the last one most players earn: the in-game 100% checklist covers the story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration. Track it on the game's own stats screen and use this guide's roadmap — the checklist is the plan. It cannot be rushed; expect it to be the final gold before the platinum.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's driving tricks — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like — and the counter runs across the whole game. Play naturally and the count climbs; to grind it, repeat stunt-friendly driving in open areas rather than in traffic. The official description does not define exactly which moves count as a stunt, so check the in-game stats to see the number move.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 250 from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game has a set of activity types — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation and more — and you only need one try of each. Early on, sample every activity you pass; the trophy pops when the last type is tried. The official list does not name the full set of types, so use the in-game activity menu as your checklist.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges at the shooting range; each needs a gold-medal score. Work through them one weapon at a time and repeat a challenge until the gold threshold shows. This is a skill grind, not a luck one — learn the scoring first, then repeat until the gold lands.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 42 challenges from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in total. Drone races are a Top Fun activity; you need a win at each of the 14 spots, not just 14 wins. Keep a note of which locations you have won at and revisit the ones left. The official list does not name the 14 locations, so we do not list them here.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 14 locations from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count per event, so winning the same race twice only counts once — you need 20 distinct race events. Try different race types and locations, and use the race menu to see which you have already won.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 20 from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a fishing rival; challenge him and out-fish him. The official list does not say where Cal is found, so look for the fishing challenge prompt in the game rather than a fixed spot we have not verified.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine and play a game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you enjoy most; this is one of the quickest trophies in the list and a good early win.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the stranger characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. Stranger strands appear as you explore Leonida, so keep an eye out for his marker on the map.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand of missions, ending with his final one. Like the other character finales, it is a matter of finding his missions and playing them through to the end.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand. His final mission is the trophy; the earlier missions in the strand are the road to it.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers are the side characters who hand out mission chains; finish eight full strands. There are more than eight strangers, so you can pick the strands you like — the five named character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward this total.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 8 strands from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission strand. Find his missions as you explore Leonida and play them to the end.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission strand, ending with his last mission. Like the other finales, it counts toward Strangers & Freaks as well.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. Meditation spots are scattered around the map; visit all 18 and meditate at each. This is the one trophy to watch for missables: if any spot is tied to a one-time story area, it could be missed, and that has not been verified in the game — so meditate at every spot you find as you go, and do not leave the set for after the story. The official list does not name the 18 spots, so we do not list locations here.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 18 spots from the official description. Missable flag: our own conservative reading of the description — the 18-spot requirement is the risk, not a verified in-game fact. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret asks you to hunt one specific, unique animal. The official list does not name the animal or where it lives, so follow Bret's missions and the in-game guidance rather than a location we have not verified.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collectible cards are found around Leonida in sets; finish any three full sets. Cards are a long collectible hunt, so pick up every card you pass and keep the set counts in view — finishing sets one at a time keeps the grind organised.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 3 sets from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is a photo-style activity — visit 100 locations and do it at each. The count is the grind, so fold it into exploring the map and do it everywhere you go, instead of backtracking later. The official list does not explain the mechanic beyond the name, so follow the in-game prompt at each spot.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 100 locations from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; finish any 50. They span activities, combat and exploration, so the count grows as you play broadly — check the challenges menu to see which ones are close to done and finish those first.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 50 from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops. Breaking line of sight and hiding until the search ends is the classic approach; a fast car and open road help. Your partner must be with you when the wanted level drops.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — do not let the wanted level clear between robberies. Plan a short route between three nearby shops and move fast from one to the next.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 3 shops from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting into a new vehicle model for the first time counts as a discovery, so drive everything you see — 100 distinct vehicles. Variety is the point: parking lots, traffic and dealerships are all fair game, and the count grows fastest when you try cars you have never driven.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 100 vehicles from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is a slow-motion aiming mode; activate it during a firefight and drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with plenty of enemies close together and line up the shots while time is slowed.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 5 enemies from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in a way that is not a scheduled flight — steal a plane and take off, for example. Expect airport security to object; a quick getaway is part of the fun. The official description does not spell out the exact method, so improvise at the airport.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are tanks, so this trophy involves the military hardware — getting into one, surviving one, or taking one on. The description is deliberately vague; expect it to pop during a moment with a Rhino in the game. We do not invent the exact trigger.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. A stealth robbery: get in, take the goods and get out without any alarm or witness spotting you. Plan the approach, watch the staff and cameras, and leave quietly — one detection ruins the attempt, so be ready to walk away and try again.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each ending with a clean escape. These are bigger jobs than shop robberies, so prepare a getaway vehicle and a route before you start each one — the escape is half the trophy.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 5 vaults from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and get away clean. Trucks are armored, so expect a fight and a wanted level; the escape is the hard half of the trophy, so have a fast car waiting.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas. The map is divided into 52 named areas; visit every one. The in-game map tracks which areas you have been to, so use it to find the gaps and drive through the corners you have not visited yet.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 52 areas from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. Every gang runs illegal operations around Leonida; rob one operation for each of the nine gangs. The official list does not name the nine gangs or their operations, so follow the in-game markers for gang activity rather than a list we have not verified.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 9 gangs from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail. A relaxing one — sit, drink, and let the trophy pop.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's frontage and out the other side, in the style of the series' classic showroom smash. Pick a showroom, line up, and floor it.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and play through a game. The trophy's name is a nod to the series' bowling past; just finish a game at that alley.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to a partnership moment — the description is deliberately cryptic and the official list gives no steps. It will likely pop during a story or side moment involving your partner; we do not invent a trigger.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this trophy, so it is about making choices — many of them. Play through the game making decisions as they come; the count builds over a full playthrough. The official description does not say which choices count, so do not chase a specific list — just keep choosing.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). PSN count target of 500 as reported by PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The name says it: succeed on a second attempt at something you failed the first time. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the official list, so treat this as one that pops naturally when you retry and succeed.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — an easter egg or an odd encounter. Explore the odd corners of the map and this one should find you. The official list gives no location, so we do not invent one.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon, in the bowling-alley area. It is a deliberately silly trophy; the alley area is the place to try it.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It is a slow earner, so launder regularly as you play rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Amount of $250,000 from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy things — clothes, food, weapons, anything sold in shops — until your total spending passes $100,000. It counts across all shops, so normal play contributes; big purchases near the end close the gap.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Amount of $100,000 from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages. Buy every garage property in the game. Garages cost money and are spread across Leonida; save up and buy each one as you can afford it, and keep a note of which you already own.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 8 garages from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone to register ten vehicles. Drive a vehicle, open the app, and register it; repeat with ten different vehicles. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good, the 100-vehicle discovery trophy.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: official trophy list (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Count of 10 vehicles from the official description. Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game.
